description: Git 命令地图：日常（status/add/commit/log/diff）、分支与合并、远程（push/fetch/pull/clone）、 撤销（amend/reset/restore）、进阶（blame/bisect/stash/rebase -i/revert/worktree）、gitignore 与 git config。Use when the user asks to commit, branch, merge, resolve conflicts, push, undo, or recover something in Git. 触发于「帮我 git 提交/合并/解冲突/推送/撤销/找回」。
